[Submitted on 19 Apr 2018 (v1), last revised 29 Mar 2021 (this version, v3)]
Title:Natural parametrization of percolation interface and pivotal points
Authors:Nina Holden, Xinyi Li, Xin Sun
View a PDF of the paper titled Natural parametrization of percolation interface and pivotal points, by Nina Holden and 2 other authors
View PDF
HTML (experimental)
Abstract:We prove that the interface of critical site percolation on the triangular lattice converges to SLE$_6$ in its natural parametrization, where the discrete interface is parametrized such that each edge is crossed in one unit of time, while the limiting curve is parametrized by the $7/4$-dimensional Minkowski content. We also prove that the scaling limit of counting measure on the pivotal points, which was proved to exist by Garban, Pete, and Schramm (2013), is the $3/4$-dimensional Minkowski content up to a deterministic multiplicative constant.
Comments:
27 pages, 3 figures. Minor revision according to the referee report. Accepted version. To appear at AIHP
Subjects:
Probability (math.PR); Mathematical Physics (math-ph)
